metadata.description: 21 modular skills for idiomatic Go 1.27, derived from Effective Go, Google Go Style Guide, Uber Go Style Guide, and Go Wiki CodeReviewComments. Backed by 51 reference files, 9 automation scripts (all with --json, --limit, --force), and 5 asset templates.

plugins.name: golang-skills
plugins.description: 21 Go 1.27 skills (each under 225 lines) with progressive disclosure, conditional cross-references, a shared verification gate, and bundled automation. Covers behavior-preserving refactoring, style, naming, error handling, testing, concurrency, generics, logging, documentation, performance, and more.
